title: Jonah_XD
source_text:
U+ṣawmo d Nәnwe kuḏʕūtle? 
Tloṯo+yawme koṣaymina, lo+kuxlina tә+mede, kŭdʕutu ʕal mәn koṣaymina? 
Qay koṣaymina u+ṣawmano aḥna?
Meqәm b Nǝnwe dәmmina aq+qamoyayḏan dәmmina d̥kәtne meqәm me Mšiḥo, d̥kə́twayne yani bariya ʕIsa Masiḥ aw ži ataye ma bun, yē Nǝnwe Ninowa. 
Kәmmina u+hno d Ninowa. 
Ninowa, tamo ʕayšiwa. 
Kәtwa malko tamo, kәrallə́k, málkowa, kәtwa malko, tamo ʕoyašwa. 
Bәṯr, ínnaqqa meqәm me Mšiḥo, kәtwa nbiyo u+Yunuṣ, yani Yawnon kәmmina bu+suryoyo. 
Kәtwa hiye. 
L Aloho mәḷḷe, ‘Yawnon, Yawnon, izúx!’ 
čunku u+ʕamo d Nǝnwe ġắlăbe ḥaṭiwa baḥ+ḥǝṭyawoṯo ġắlăbe. 
Be mәqqa kәtwa hawno di+tәǧara, mǝqqa b̥kul+mede laqǝddā́mwayneste, bas bi+ḥṭìṯoste laqәddā́m d̥kul+mèdewayne.
E, mə́ḷḷele, omar, ‘Izúx mašǝ́r ʕal u+ʕamo d Nǝnwe ddoʕar mi+ḥṭiṯayḏe’, omar. 
Yáwnonste yuḏóyowa, ay+yuḏoye ŭ an+nәnwoye lo+rәḥmiwa ḥḏoḏe, lo+rәḥmiwa. 
Híyeste, rawәx bi+gamiye dәzzeyo. 
Yani hiye, l Aloho mәḷḷe, ‘Zux l Nǝnwe’. 
Hiye mәftakarle, Yawnon, ‘Oh’, omar, ‘ṭrәzzehәn lu+hălā̀k, zatan lә+grәḥmìnanne hanәk, an+nәnwoye’. 
Neyse, rawǝx bi+gamiye, azzé laf Iṣpanya, čunku lo+kobaʕ dǝzzeyo dmadʕarre mi+ḥṭiṯo, hanәk. 
Nbíyowa Yawnon, bәṯr azzé dәzzé támoda, i+gamiye mḥela šalqat ġắlăbe hawxa, koʕobar maye li+gamiye. 
Kozayʕi dgawe di+gamiye, kozayʕi kulle, kǝmmi, hәn kə́ttǝwa ṣalme, ṣuġḏiwa laṣ+ṣalme, mṣalәnwa әmmiwa, ‘Ya aṣ+ṣalmayḏan, maxléṣulan mu+medano, yani maš+šalqani, falā́n’. 
Tabi lo+hne. 
Aloho soyamwa hawxa. 
Bәṯr әmmi, ‘Mḥalqina ṗәšk̇, kito ḥa+ḥaṭoyo baynoṯayna. 
Be háynayo u+ḥaṭoyo, gәmḥalqínale mi+gamiye’. 
Yawnon mәḷḷe, ‘Mḥalequ ono mi+gamiye, g̊xulṣo!’ 
Yani g̊kolәn aš+šalqe. 
U+hnoste, u+ṗәšk̇ste nafәl l Yawnon zatan. 
Neyse mḥalaqqe mi+gamiye Yawnon, qām Yunuṣbalәġə́ kәmmina, kito nune, kǝmmina bu+tәrki Yunuṣbalәġə́, hayo blәʕla Yawnon, ŭ azzayo ŭ azzayo, mbela hul l Nǝnwe lu+sahil d Nǝnwe, ḥfәxla tamo, mḥalaqla li+hno. 
Mṣalewa bgawa di+nǝnto, bgawa di+nǝnto ṣoyamwa ŭ borakwa. 
Mawxa kali. 
Bǝṯr mu+ṭăraf d Aloho, hawi hawxa ilono, ŭ hno, ŭ ṭelolo. 
Yáwnonste mu+ḥemo mžәdle ruḥe qmu+ṭelolo du+hnawo, du+ilonawo. 
Hawxa mbasamle lebe fṣīḥ d̥kit ilono, čunku ḥémowa aʕle.
Bǝṯr naqla+ḥreto u+ilonawo hawxa šaʕәṯ, kamәč bәḥḏoḏe. 
Qḥīr ġắlăbe, omar, yani ‘Qay hawxa hawi u+ilonano? 
Obéwayli hno, obéwayli ṭelolo, basímowa, uʕdo hawi ḥem‿aʕli’. 
Bәṯr naqla+ḥreto Aloho ǧġīl aʕme, omar, ‘Yawnon, Yawnon’, omar, ‘U+medawo, dlo elux xlәqlux, dlo+taʕibat ebe sәmlux, bnaqla dhawi ŭ hne, kamәd ʕal ḥḏode, komәqḥorat mine? 
Ono áydarbo lo+mǝqḥǝṇṇo ʕal u+ʕamo dʔeli xlәqli biḏi, u+ʕamo d Nǝnwe?’
Fahәm Yawnon, azzé bayn u+ʕamo, krәzle, krәzle ʕal a+ḥṭohe hawxa, ‘Xayifo dʕaru ma+ḥṭohaṯxu, Tgünahlarınızdan dönünT yani omar, ‘Dʕaru!’ 
krәzle, krәzle ʕal Aloho. 
Bәṯr u+malko d̥tamo šlәḥle u+toġo d̥qarʕe, maḥatle tamo, lwәšle ǧule qṭiʕe, ŭ mәḷḷe lu+hno kule, mәrle lu+ʕamo d Nǝnwe kule…
Li+ǧamaʕa kula. 
Omar, ‘U+ʕamo ŭ aḥ+ḥayewәn kulle gzәbṭina ṣawmo, šan Aloho dәmsamaḥlan ma+ḥṭohayḏan’.  
Kulle tloṯo+yawme tloṯo+lalye zbәṭṭe ṣawmo. 
 Lo+xәlle ŭ lә+štalle. 
L Aloho msamḥile. 
Qantə́r qantə́r, i+baġalṯo mḥalaqla fema li+mәlk̇ayḏa, xila, omar, ‘Zarʕo lo+noḥat minax!’ 
Uʕdo ab+baġalyoṯe lǝ+k̬miwaldi, qantə́r nazәn haaa nazәn, sar go ha rožiya xwa xwar. 
Go, ‘Zarʕat šǝ ta nawē xwar!’ 
Omar, ‘Lowelax, u+zarʕayḏax howe qšiʕo’. 
Lo+komiwaldo, i+baġalṯo lǝ+k̬miwaldo.
Qayimi, mšabaḥḥe l Aloho, ŭ l Aloho msamḥile, d Nǝnwe. 
Áḥnaste u+ʕamo mšiḥoyo kәmmina, kul+ʔәnsan kәtle ḥṭohe, kolozam zәbṭina ṣawmo me lebayna. 
Kobina ... komarḥqina ruḥayna mi+ḥṭiṯo kula, ŭ mu+muklo kotawrina i+nafšayḏan, kәmmina, ‘D Aloho msamaḥ aḥ+ḥṭohe d̥kosaymina’, čunku kul+ʔәnsan baḥ+ḥayayḏe, kul+yawmo koḥoṭina b̥kul+mede. 
šan dmisamḥi a+ḥṭohe, koḥǝšwina ruḥayna ḥaṭoye, čunku mawxa kozǝbṭina u+ṣawmo d Nǝnwe.
